Update #63 Notes

September 20, 2025 – around 12:00 / EA V1.63


This patch fixes several small issues~


1. Fixed a bug where quickly swapping Linkers in tactical plans could clear the deck.


2. Fixed abnormal Favor data for some Godsouls.


3. Fixed incorrect facial expressions in certain story scenes.


4. Fixed an issue where viewing some enemy artworks in battle could only be closed with Esc.


5. Fixed a crash when right-clicking Evisoul portraits in the tutorial boss fight against Bullock.


6. Attempted to fix an issue where the "Linker Mis" scan-save achievement would not trigger properly (scan logic adjusted).


7. Attempted to fix anomalies in the mod count limit.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/a02d2fd1a85686669c8943c8a5ea7f90eabc7386.gif"]


Last night we temporarily pushed 1.62, but before finishing the notes we discovered a bug report from players—[Linker gifting was not working].


Today we re-released as 1.63.


Sorry for the trouble—here’s a gift! A brand-new mini wallpaper [Tiger Girl’s Summer Glance] has been added as free DLC.


(Free DLC must be downloaded manually. Stored in your game installation folder:)


H:\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\GODSOUL\\DLC_FreeWallpapers


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573850/_/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/ea29c2b0f5089afbbf05494ae42a151c0f2f3a7c.png"]

Rebellion GodSoul Progress Report

The Roguelike mode is under intense development. Once completed, you’ll be able to enjoy "Rebellion GodSoul" fully as a roguelike card game. (The content is large—several more months are needed.)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/9dc968dcb53fe2370d8f2d70734c5a4b898f87a1.png"]


If you feel this game is worth it, please recommend "Rebellion GodSoul" to your friends! Your support is our biggest motivation to keep creating more free content for you!!

notes.title: Update 59: Auto/Manual Save Separation & Story Skip Optimization!
notes.notes:
Hello, handsome Rebels! Good afternoon! 《Rebellion GodSoul》 has just received some new convenience features—especially for save files and story skip optimizations!


📅 EA V1.59 – Around 16:00, September 8, 2025


Update Details:

[olist]
[]
Save Slot & Sorting Optimization


[]
Manual saves and auto saves are now displayed separately.
[/]
[]
All previous auto saves will now be treated as manual saves.
[/]
[]
Auto save list now sorts by date automatically, with the latest save shown at the top for easier access.
[/]
[]
If you wish to clean up saves, please go to:
C:\Users\【Your Username】\AppData\Local\GodSoul\Saved\SaveGames and delete manually.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/89737c2a79d55fe838ca7e05eac1d3b56c189c96.png"]
[/]
[/]

[]
Transition Effect Optimization


[]
Adjusted some transition effects for better presentation.
[/]
[/]

[]
Abyss Connection Adjustment – now with clearer directionality
[/]

[]
Story Skip Expansion


[]
Spirit-joining story events can now be skipped. Skipping still grants the Spirit as normal (previously, due to bugs, joining and some affinity events could not be skipped).
[/]
[]
Now, except for the protagonist’s naming scene, all story events can be skipped with one click.
[/]
[]
Tip: Story skip function is located in the gear icon at the top right menu.
[/]
[/]

[]
Localization Update


[]
Added Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese draft translations for Kami Aposta’s affinity story (Part 6 onward).
[/]
[]
During EA, localization is done internally and may not be perfect. We welcome feedback from players fluent in English/Japanese via Discord.
[/]
[/]
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/eb22d5593c83dfd76429296b1b5c0e4b001b6588.gif"]


Additionally, the first batch of Steam Points Shop items for 《Rebellion GodSoul》 has been submitted for review, and is expected to go live later this week or next week!

notes.title: Update #55: New Kami Coopration Story Finale! Includes a Special ASMR
notes.notes:
Good evening, handsome Rebels! Rebellion GODSOUL EA1.55 Major Update is live!
Thank you for waiting—this is our very first major content update. We hope you enjoy it this summer!



📝 EA1.55 Core Updates
Kami Aposta’s Affection Story – Final Chapter
Split into 6 segments, almost like 6 chapters at once!
Over 20,000 words of new story, dozens of new CGs, and new characters appear.
👉 How to access: Base → Chibi character → Scroll down to the very bottom.

Special Event: ASMR Performance
A 12-minute scene performed by a Japanese ASMR voice actor, bringing you a unique and mysterious soundscape.

Card UI Overhaul
Now more bouncy and smoother than ever!
Highly recommend enabling “Card Master Mode” for the best play experience!




⚠ Note: Due to time constraints, the English and Japanese versions of the new story may be delayed by 1–2 weeks as translations are still being finalized.




*Once again, for the smoothest card experience, make sure to enable “Card Master Mode”!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/f527564d13eb4e82d0b83cb934c60ad128b8d8c6.png"]



Point Shop Items
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/8864d0c1de1ef6642dabe79d5c71a6df4acee7df.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/02c3f544a4ae6f41434b31e107bf3312b48210ef.jpg"]

- The first batch of dynamic avatars and backgrounds is being prepared.
- All backgrounds will be full-screen and seamless, with no black bars.
- Quality is significantly higher than in our past games.
- Many have requested a wedding dress background—we’ll do our best to make it happen!

> Trading Cards will only have one release opportunity, so they will come a bit later.


Rougelike Mode
- Currently under heavy development.
- Includes: brand-new cards, shops, unique mechanics different from the main story, out-of-run progression, swappable heroine/CG system.
- Estimated release: around the end of the year.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/b8fcdec36c3d8d5ab7807caeb0bce71220ce788a.png"]



About Voice Acting
Our main focus is currently on roguelike mode, card balance adjustments, and new story development.
Therefore, this new story update has no voice acting (except for ASMR and certain special scenes).
But rest assured—the story volume is much larger than planned, and we’ll continue to deliver rich content.
When the game reaches a new milestone, we plan to add additional voice acting in bulk.
We sincerely apologize and thank you for your support. It’s your encouragement that keeps us going!

notes.title: Update #54: Ice Cream Compensation! Urgent Fix for [Current Character Has Left]
notes.notes:
handsome Rebels, sorry to bother you this late at night.


EA1.54 has been released as an emergency update, fixing a critical issue in specific situations:
When there was only one character left in the party, the Tactical Plan would incorrectly determine that [The current character has left the team], causing the deck to become uneditable.


We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. This issue has now been fixed.
Once you update to version 1.54, you will no longer encounter this problem.


As compensation, we’ve added a new 4K wallpaper — [Goddess Ice Cream] (Phantom: Athena) — to the free DLC pack. Thank you for your understanding and support.


This is a small patch. The last ice cream bonus was [Alice]. For functional update details, please refer to the previous EA1.53 update announcement.

notes.title: Update #53: Added card damage preview and other player-requested battle features
notes.notes:
handsome Rebels, happy weekend! The EA 1.53 version of "Rebellious Godsoul" is now live!



In response to many player requests, we’ve added the following important \[Battle Features]

1. Added a quick Phantom switching feature in the Tactical Plan menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/28f206b3e2ef762d7b5708e8c1383a218c91171f.png"]*This is the quick access for switching Phantoms. Feel free to leave suggestions in the comments.

2. Card damage preview is finally here! Cards now automatically calculate the final damage based on your current stats, buffs, etc., and display it with a simplified formula during battle for greater clarity.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/e77a043211b7a4270935017eeedaba410db1ef3a.png"]

https://discord.gg/zGfw5TcNZG

— Minor Fixes —

4. Enhanced the mechanism for scanning Phantom saves to obtain achievements.

5. Fixed the card collection display issue. Now only base cards are counted (generated/derived cards have been removed from statistics to ensure accuracy).

6. Fixed an issue where a branch CG in \[Cyber Miss] favorability story displayed incorrectly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/b22792b0dd47e71935f82f8ae1836820cc2ee0f3.png"]

About the Major Update:

We plan to release the major update next week (or the week after at the latest), adding \[Kami Aposta’s Favorability Story Part 6], with over 20,000 characters—almost a full main story chapter!

We’re just finishing coloring the last two CGs~

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/ae73047516c2e22a990f56e04d6f1a59cdeef5aa.png"]

Extra Update:

Free wallpaper pack added — Alice Dessert Dynamic Version

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573850/_/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/99b59992bb93d4268da9cf6248a03eba8e906058.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/7001253c877735c444d275b1168b4dcbc172c0b8.png"]





Development Progress:

After a month of technical breakthroughs and design, the \[Story Workshop] feature has entered stable production. To make it easier for players to create content, we are also developing a story editor in parallel. Once released, players will be able to create and upload story packs to the Workshop.

These are partial UI prototypes. A tutorial will be provided when the feature launches.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/2eb1d5b6629a0ec7f17ba4b11bcc6903f8099419.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/31a0478893f91b2e4299d66223fdf655f9378744.png"]

We also plan to release Workshop features related to cards and stages in the future. \[This project is more challenging than the Story Workshop.]



The Roguelike mode is also in development. Most UI prototypes are complete, but it will take several more months to finish the full mode. We’ll share real gameplay footage as soon as it’s ready to show.



Once again, thank you for playing "Rebellious Godsoul"!

If you think the game is worth it, please recommend it to your friends—your support greatly helps our development!

notes.title: Update #49 · 2025 Roadmap · Points Shop Preview · Free Static Avatars First!
notes.notes:
Cool rebels, long time no see! The EA v1.49 mid-sized update has arrived~




1. 【Repeated Battle Issue】Optimization:

Nodes in Heterotopia/Abyss that have already been cleared will no longer trigger battles or story events during single explorations.

New feature added before exploration: You can now select an unlocked 【Sign】as your starting point.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/92bda18ba23d3c751f41e295fd89b022e6f90919.png"]




2. Favor event improvements for 10 Linkers — enjoy more detailed and expressive character interactions!

Updated characters:

Cyber-Myth, Apollo, Kaguya, Luoshen, Cupid, Gaia, Muse, Ratatoskr, Chang’e

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/75212bf4a159e0755971beb69aedbda6714a2964.jpg"]




3. Fixed occasional background flickering in 【Sacred Tree Heterotopia】

4. Fixed incorrect stat display in Sign areas




A new free DLC wallpaper featuring 【Teacher Medusa】 is now available to support exam season! (Due to a Steam bug, the base game update may get stuck when auto-downloading wallpapers — to avoid this, we’ve removed auto-download for free DLC wallpapers. Please download them manually if interested.)




Static Steam profile avatars have been updated. You can now set them directly from your Steam profile! Feel free to download and use them too.

(It seems Steam randomly shows 5 out of 7 avatars at a time.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/48217d3f2ea848588f8b22b42cc7674d9327c492.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/5147555b9a65a6a2706a776b40c333d816a473e7.png"]




You’re welcome to download and use them directly. (Preview above; full set at the end of this post)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/fe146647baf050e814850eff79400b9f5b7ffe73.jpg"]




🛠️ Future Update Plans:




Between EA1.0~2.0, several transitional updates are planned. These will include card/monster balance adjustments, gameplay optimization, and further enhancements to Linker stories. Some QoL features such as renaming the protagonist will also be added.




Gameplay Optimization: Nodes already cleared in Heterotopia/Abyss will no longer block progress with repeated battles/events.




Major Future Plan: Chapter 1 Remake

As the current Chapter 1 didn’t meet our narrative expectations, we’ve decided to rebuild it from the ground up.

【New Chapter 1】 is expected to launch in Q3 of this year. It will be a large update featuring a brand-new story that replaces the old one.

There will also be a Story Recap feature to let players with old save files enjoy the new Chapter 1 content.




Don’t worry — all existing CGs related to the current heroines in Chapter 1 will be preserved.

More interactions between the heroines and the protagonist will be added, with a greater focus on character development and strengthening the protagonist’s presence.



EA2.0 (ETA: July ~ August)
New challenge stages (e.g. boss rush) and fun post-game events after clearing EA1.0~

Implementation of Kami 's Chapter 6 personal storyline (20k+ words!)~

Dynamic avatars, character cards, and backgrounds will be added to the Points Shop (preview shown — animations in progress)

And of course, there will be more than this when the full update launches!




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/1431e935339b0d6f68272d1eb725d566d0fb660e.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/a2aa69a5711b8c200844df26a3a7452ae94ba518.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/6abeed63e3a2bda81da106ce5e6774f60a23e43a.png"]



EA2.5 (ETA: August ~ October)
Main story update: The 【Hoshimu Arc】 begins!

Includes:

New cards

New Linkers

24 new Hoshimu favor events

12 new Lincy favor events



EA3.0 (ETA: October ~ December / or early next year)
Main story continuation: 【Moonshadow Arc】

New playable Godsoul: Moonshadow, complete with her own deck and favor events

Additional new cards and Linkers will also be added




*Please note: This roadmap may shift based on development progress. If delays occur, we’ll compensate with free wallpapers or skins. We’ll do our best to serve you!



Major Content (Date TBA):
【Roguelike Mode】 ETA: October ~ December (tentative)

We want the game to offer more replayability and better showcase the girls' charm!

This core gameplay mode is in planning and will take at least 5 months.

It will be independent from the main story, with new mechanics for acquiring cards and Linkers (such as building your deck and team mid-run). Linkers may gain extra abilities (passives, etc.).

Includes base-building elements and special mini-scenes within the Roguelike mode.

Some rest/personal scenes for this mode are currently in production.




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/51454b7fcf48a5f6b4951ef58a6083edb449daea.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/c76fd36ee1680e8d391e7781d0f78a7b38bec0eb.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/519f423949f351f75739769c9c265d04130992fc.png"]




【Steam Workshop】under research

We plan to launch Story Workshop first — tentatively around August ~ October. Card and stage creation tools will follow later.

Players will be able to add custom events or story expansions for your favorite Linkers/heroines!

Card and stage Workshop tools will be rolled out in future updates.




Remaining Avatars:

Feel free to use these avatars anywhere you like, including on your social media accounts or other platforms.

notes.title: Update #48: Free Mouse Cursor Gift & Map Exploration Markers Added (Important)
notes.notes:
Around 13:00 on May 28, 2025 – EA V1.48 Update

1. Major Feature!
The highly requested [Exploration Status Indicator] is now live in its first version!
